name: Far East Consortium International Limited
summary: Far East Consortium International Limited, an investment holding company, engages in property development activities in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the Czech Republic, and rest of Europe. It operates through Property Development, Property Investment, Hotel Operations and Management, Car Park Operations and Facilities Management, Gaming Operations, Securities and Financial Product Investments, and Provision of Mortgage Services segments.
